parameters.name: profile
parameters.label: Configuration profile(s)
parameters.usage: Configuration profile to use. Can use multiple (comma separated).

parameters.name: params-file
parameters.label: Parameter options
parameters.usage: Set the parameters of the pipeline using a JSON file configuration file (i.e. 'params.json'). All parameters defined as JSON type must be this way. For example, the JSON can contain: "alphaFoldOptions": "--max_template=2024-01-01 --multimer". WARNING: passing the option '--alphaFoldOptions' in command line will throw an error when the option contains '-' or '--' characters which are not appreciated by nextflow.

parameters.name: fastaPath
parameters.label: Input fasta directory
parameters.usage: Path to the input directory which contains the fasta files.

parameters.name: genomeAnnotationPath
parameters.label: Annotation path
parameters.usage: Path to genome/proteome annotations folder used to predict the protein 3D structure.

parameters.name: afMassiveDatabase
parameters.label: afMassive database
parameters.usage: Path to the database required by AFMassive.

parameters.name: afMassiveHelp
parameters.label: massivebFold help
parameters.usage: Display all the options available to run AFMassive. Use this option in combination with -profile singularity.

parameters.name: afMassiveOptions
parameters.label: afMassive options
parameters.usage: Specific options for AFMassive. As AFMassive is an AlphaFold-like tool, standard AlphaFold options are passed using the --alphaFoldOptions option.

parameters.name: frommsas
parameters.label: from msas
parameters.usage: When true, the pipeline will skip the multiple sequence alignments (msas).

parameters.name: launchAfMassive
parameters.label: launch AfMassive
parameters.usage: Launch AFMassive

parameters.name: numberOfModels
parameters.label: number of models
parameters.usage: Number of models that will be evaluated by AFMassive. This parameter is taken into account when --launchAfMassive is true. (Default 5)

parameters.name: multimerVersions
parameters.label: Multimer versions
parameters.usage: AlphaFold multimer model versions (v1, v2, v3) which will be evaluated by AFMassive. This parameter is taken into account when --launchAfMassive is true. The list of the versions to be evaluated must be provided with a comma separated string, e.g. 'v1,v2', Default is 'v1,v2,v3'.

parameters.name: predictionsPerModel
parameters.label: predictions per model
parameters.usage: Number of predictions per model which will be evaluated by AFMassive. This parameter is taken into account when --launchAfMassive is true. (Default 5)

parameters.name: onlymsas
parameters.label: only msas
parameters.usage: When true, the pipeline will only generate the multiple sequence alignments (msas).

parameters.name: useGpu
parameters.label: useGpu
parameters.usage: Run the prediction model on GPU. AFMassive can run either on CPU or GPU.
